helpers (vectorised; scipy.stats.rankdata only, never scipy.spearmanr in a loop)\n# =================================================================================================\ndef pearson(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float:\n    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)\n    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)\n    if a.size < 2 or np.std(a) == 0 or np.std(b) == 0:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return float(np.corrcoef(a, b)[0, 1])\n\n\ndef _safe_rank(x: np.ndarray, name: str = \"\") -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"scipy.stats.rankdata propagates NaN to the WHOLE output array if a single element is NaN.\n    Every caller here is expected to have already excluded/filled undefined entries; if a stray NaN\n    still shows up, impute with the column median (log it loudly) rather than silently returning an\n    all-NaN rank vector that then cascades into 'point=nan' results downstream.\"\"\"\n    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)\n    bad = np.isnan(x)\n    if bad.any():\n        med = np.nanmedian(x) if not bad.all() else 0.0\n        logger.warning(f\"_safe_rank: {int(bad.sum())}/{len(x)} NaN in '{name}' before ranking -- \"\n                       f\"imputing with the column median ({med}); investigate the upstream mask/fill.\")\n        x = np.where(bad, med, x)\n    return rankdata(x)\n\n\ndef spearman(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float:\n    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)\n    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)\n    if a.size < 2:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return pearson(_safe_rank(a, \"spearman:a\"), _safe_rank(b, \"spearman:b\"))\n\n\ndef ordinal_rank_rows(X: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Fast ordinal (no tie-averaging) rank along axis=1; fine for continuous simulated data.\"\"\"\n    return np.argsort(np.argsort(X, axis=1, kind=\"quicksort\"), axis=1).astype(np.float64) + 1.0\n\n\ndef row_pearson(A: np.ndarray, B: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Vectorised Pearson correlation per row of A (n_rows,n) vs B (n_rows,n).\"\"\"\n    Ac = A - A.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    Bc = B - B.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    num = (Ac * Bc).sum(axis=1)\n    den = np.sqrt((Ac ** 2).sum(axis=1) * (Bc ** 2).sum(axis=1))\n    with np.errstate(divide=\"ignore\", invalid=\"ignore\"):\n        out = num / den\n    return out\n\n\ndef safe_log10(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)\n    return np.log10(np.clip(x, 1e-9, None))\n\n\ndef ols_resid_rank(y: np.ndarray, covariate_ranks: list[np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Rank-transform y, regress its ranks on [1, covariate_ranks...] by OLS, return residuals.\"\"\"\n    ry = _safe_rank(y, \"ols_resid_rank:y\").astype(np.float64)\n    n = len(ry)\n    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [_safe_rank(c, \"ols_resid_rank:cov\").astype(np.float64)\n                                        for c in covariate_ranks])\n    try:\n        beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, ry, rcond=None)\n    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:\n        return np.full(n, np.nan)\n    return ry - X @ beta\n\n\ndef partial_spearman(value: np.ndarray, target: np.ndarray, covariates: list[np.ndarray]) -> float:\n    rv = ols_resid_rank(value, covariates)\n    rt = ols_resid_rank(target, covariates)\n    if np.any(np.isnan(rv)) or np.any(np.isnan(rt)):\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return pearson(rv, rt)\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# Row loading / joining\n# =================================================================================================\ndef load_rows(rows_glob: str) -> list[dict]:\n    paths = sorted(WS.glob(rows_glob))\n    rows = []\n    for p in paths:\n        try:\n            rows.append(json.loads(p.read_text()))\n        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:\n            logger.warning(f\"skip unreadable row {p}: {e}\")\n    logger.info(f\"loaded {len(rows)} row files from {rows_glob}\")\n    return rows\n\n\ndef load_labels() -> dict[str, dict]:\n    return json.loads((WS / \"labels_map.json\").read_text())[\"rows\"]\n\n\ndef joined_frame(rows: list[dict], labels: dict[str, dict]) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    \"\"\"One row per model with label-sourced repo/family/lineage/class/stratum/status/BALANCED/PRODUCT,\n    plus n_params/candidates/etc. from the row file itself.\"\"\"\n    recs = []\n    for row in rows:\n        repo = row.get(\"repo\")\n        lab = labels.get(repo)\n        if lab is None:\n            logger.warning(f\"{repo}: not in labels_map.json -- falling back to the row's own copy\")\n            lab = {\"BALANCED\": row.get(\"BALANCED\"), \"PRODUCT\": row.get(\"PRODUCT\"), \"family\": row.get(\"family\"),\n                   \"lineage\": row.get(\"lineage\"), \"class\": row.get(\"class\"), \"stratum\": row.get(\"stratum\"),\n                   \"status\": \"graded\" if row.get(\"graded\") else \"unknown\"}\n        recs.append({\n            \"repo\": repo, \"resolved_sha\": row.get(\"resolved_sha\"),\n            \"family\": lab.get(\"family\"), \"lineage\": lab.get(\"lineage\"), \"class\": lab.get(\"class\"),\n            \"stratum\": lab.get(\"stratum\"), \"label_status\": lab.get(\"status\"),\n            \"BALANCED\": lab.get(\"BALANCED\"), \"PRODUCT\": lab.get(\"PRODUCT\"),\n            \"n_params\": row.get(\"n_params\"), \"row_status\": row.get(\"status\"),\n            \"screen16_file_sha256\": row.get(\"screen16_file_sha256\"), \"prereg_hash\": row.get(\"prereg_hash\"),\n            \"candidate_seconds\": row.get(\"candidate_seconds\", {}), \"candidates\": row.get(\"candidates\", {}),\n            \"oracle\": row.get(\"oracle\", {}), \"offset_control\": row.get(\"offset_control\"),\n            \"C1_linear_range_eps\": row.get(\"C1_linear_range_eps\"),\n            \"C1_linearity\": row.get(\"C1_linearity\"),\n            \"C1_nonlinear_at_primary\": row.get(\"C1_nonlinear_at_primary\"),\n            \"wall_s\": row.get(\"wall_s\"),\n            \"lite\": any(f_.get(\"code\") == \"ANCHOR_LITE\" for f_ in (row.get(\"flags\") or [])),\n        })\n    return pd.DataFrame.from_records(recs)\n\n\ndef graded_mask(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:\n    return (df[\"BALANCED\"].notna()) & (df[\"row_status\"] == \"ok\") & (df[\"stratum\"] == \"chat\")\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# C9 AtP-vs-true-patching validation (PREREG / plan fallback #9)\n# =================================================================================================\ndef assess_c9_atp_reliability(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Look up C9.atp_vs_true_pearson on the ATP_VALIDATION_MODELS rows (any status/stratum -- this is\n    a measurement-quality check, not a correlation, so it is read off the full df, before the graded\n    mask). If ANY validation model present has pearson < 0.5, C9 is ATP_UNRELIABLE. If none of the\n    validation models are present with a defined pearson, the row is 'not_verifiable' and AtP is kept\n    (per the fallback plan's own wording).\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, float] = {}\n    for repo in ATP_VALIDATION_MODELS:\n        hit = df.index[df[\"repo\"] == repo]\n        if len(hit) == 0:\n            continue\n        cd = df.at[hit[0], \"candidates\"] or {}\n        v = (cd.get(\"C9\", {}) or {}).get(\"atp_vs_true_pearson\")\n        if v is not None and math.isfinite(float(v)):\n            found[repo] = float(v)\n    if not found:\n        return {\"status\": \"not_verifiable\", \"atp_unreliable\": False, \"threshold\": ATP_RELIABILITY_THRESHOLD,\n                \"validation_models\": ATP_VALIDATION_MODELS, \"found\": {}, \"triggered\": {},\n                \"reason\": \"no ATP_VALIDATION_MODELS row present with a defined atp_vs_true_pearson; \"\n                          \"AtP is kept (not verifiable)\"}\n    triggered = {r: v for r, v in found.items() if v < ATP_RELIABILITY_THRESHOLD}\n    atp_unreliable = bool(triggered)\n    return {\"status\": \"ATP_UNRELIABLE\" if atp_unreliable else \"verified_reliable\",\n            \"atp_unreliable\": atp_unreliable, \"threshold\": ATP_RELIABILITY_THRESHOLD,\n            \"validation_models\": ATP_VALIDATION_MODELS, \"found\": found, \"triggered\": triggered,\n            \"reason\": (f\"{len(triggered)}/{len(found)} validation model(s) below \"\n                       f\"{ATP_RELIABILITY_THRESHOLD}: {triggered}\" if atp_unreliable else\n                       f\"all {len(found)} validation model(s) >= {ATP_RELIABILITY_THRESHOLD}: {found}\")}\n\n\ndef rewrite_c9_for_atp_unreliable(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    \"\"\"When ATP_UNRELIABLE: true_patch_value becomes C9's PRIMARY value for every model (not just the\n    validation set), and true_patch_pole_refuse/comply/k8 become C9's pole_refuse/pole_comply/k8 for\n    every model. The original AtP numbers are preserved under 'atp'/'atp_pole_refuse'/... (candidate\n    id C9, variant 'atp' in candidate_values_live.json). A model whose true_patch_* field is itself\n    absent (not yet measured / TIME_CAP) is left UNDEFINED for that field rather than falling back\n    silently to AtP, and (for pole_refuse/pole_comply) is recorded in 'c9_true_patch_pole_missing' so\n    s3_check can EXCLUDE it from the pole comparison instead of worst-valuing it (worst-value\n    substitution is a PREREG S1/S3 rule for a measured-but-undefined candidate, not for 'we didn't\n    measure this field under the corrected method yet').\"\"\"\n    df = df.copy()\n    new_cands, missing_flags = [], []\n    for cd in df[\"candidates\"]:\n        cd = dict(cd or {})\n        c9 = dict(cd.get(\"C9\", {}) or {})\n        c9[\"atp_value\"] = c9.get(\"value\")\n        c9[\"atp_undefined\"] = bool(c9.get(\"undefined\", c9.get(\"value\") is None))\n        c9[\"atp_reason\"] = c9.get(\"reason\")\n        tv = c9.get(\"true_patch_value\")\n        if tv is not None:\n            c9[\"value\"], c9[\"undefined\"], c9[\"reason\"] = tv, False, None\n        else:\n            c9[\"value\"], c9[\"undefined\"] = None, True\n            # prefer the model's own true_patch_reason (e.g. TIME_CAP) over a generic message\n            c9[\"reason\"] = c9.get(\"true_patch_reason\") or \\\n                \"ATP_UNRELIABLE: true_patch_value not available for this model\"\n        miss = {}\n        for pv, true_key, reason_key in ((\"pole_refuse\", \"true_patch_pole_refuse\", \"pole_refuse_reason\"),\n                                         (\"pole_comply\", \"true_patch_pole_comply\", \"pole_comply_reason\"),\n                                         (\"k8\", \"true_patch_k8\", \"k8_reason\")):\n            c9[\"atp_\" + pv] = c9.get(pv)\n            tv2 = c9.get(true_key)\n            if tv2 is not None:\n                c9[pv], c9[reason_key] = tv2, None\n            else:\n                c9[pv] = None\n                own_reason = c9.get(true_key + \"_reason\")\n                c9[reason_key] = own_reason or (f\"ATP_UNRELIABLE: {true_key} not available for this \"\n                                                 f\"model (treated as missing, not worst-valued)\")\n                if pv != \"k8\":\n                    miss[pv] = True\n        cd[\"C9\"] = c9\n        new_cands.append(cd)\n        missing_flags.append(miss)\n    df[\"candidates\"] = new_cands\n    df[\"c9_true_patch_pole_missing\"] = missing_flags\n    return df\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# Per-candidate value extraction + worst-value rule\n# =================================================================================================\ndef extract_variant(cdict: dict, variant: str) -> tuple[float | None, bool, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return (value, undefined, reason) for one variant of one candidate's dict (already the\n    row[\"candidates\"][cid] sub-dict).\"\"\"\n    if variant == \"primary\":\n        v = cdict.get(\"value\")\n        und = bool(cdict.get(\"undefined\", v is None))\n        return v, und, cdict.get(\"reason\")\n    if variant == \"late\":\n        v = cdict.get(\"late\")\n        return v, v is None, None if v is not None else \"no late-window value\"\n    if variant in (\"pole_refuse\", \"pole_comply\"):\n        v = cdict.get(variant)\n        return v, v is None, cdict.get(variant + \"_reason\")\n    if variant == \"k8\":\n        v = cdict.get(\"k8\")\n        return v, v is None, cdict.get(\"k8_reason\")\n    if variant == \"oracle\":\n        v = cdict.get(\"oracle\")\n        return v, v is None, cdict.get(\"oracle_reason\")\n    if variant == \"null_p95\":\n        v = cdict.get(\"null_p95\")\n        return v, v is None, None if v is not None else \"no direction null defined\"\n    if variant == \"atp\":\n        # C9-only, only meaningful once ATP_UNRELIABLE has swapped 'value' for true_patch_value (see\n        # rewrite_c9_for_atp_unreliable): the original AtP value is preserved here under 'atp_value'.\n        v = cdict.get(\"atp_value\")\n        return v, bool(cdict.get(\"atp_undefined\", v is None)), cdict.get(\"atp_reason\")\n    raise ValueError(variant)\n\n\ndef build_primary_series(df: pd.DataFrame, cid: str) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    \"\"\"DataFrame indexed like df with columns value, undefined, reason for candidate cid's primary value.\"\"\"\n    vals, unds, reas = [], [], []\n    for cd in df[\"candidates\"]:\n        c = (cd or {}).get(cid, {})\n        v, u, r = extract_variant(c, \"primary\")\n        vals.append(v)\n        unds.append(u)\n        reas.append(r)\n    return pd.DataFrame({\"value\": vals, \"undefined\": unds, \"reason\": reas}, index=df.index)\n\n\ndef worst_value(oriented_values: np.ndarray, undefined: np.ndarray) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Worst observed panel value AFTER orientation = the minimum oriented value among defined entries\n    (an oriented candidate is supposed to correlate positively with safety; the worst-looking value is\n    the smallest one).\"\"\"\n    defined = oriented_values[~undefined]\n    if defined.size == 0:\n        return -1e9  # degenerate: everything undefined; use a sentinel that is worse than anything\n    return float(np.min(defined))\n\n\ndef apply_worst_value_rule(raw_values: np.ndarray, undefined: np.ndarray, sign: float | None) -> np.ndarray:\n    \"\"\"Return ORIENTED values with undefined entries replaced by the panel's worst oriented value.\n    sign=None (two-sided/descriptive candidates) -> no orientation applied (sign=1), no worst-value\n    substitution requested by S1/S3 since these never enter the pass rules; we still fill for safety.\"\"\"\n    s = 1.0 if sign is None else sign\n    oriented = np.array([np.nan if v is None else s * float(v) for v in raw_values], dtype=np.float64)\n    und = np.array(undefined, dtype=bool) | np.isnan(oriented)\n    w = worst_value(oriented, und)\n    out = np.where(und, w, oriented)\n    return out\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# Bootstrap / permutation machinery\n# =================================================================================================\ndef lineage_groups(lineages: np.ndarray) -> dict[Any, np.ndarray]:\n    g = defaultdict(list)\n    for i, lin in enumerate(lineages):\n        g[lin].append(i)\n    return {k: np.array(v) for k, v in g.items()}\n\n\ndef lineage_bootstrap_resample_idx(groups: dict[Any, np.ndarray], rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:\n    keys = list(groups.keys())\n    draw = rng.integers(0, len(keys), size=len(keys))\n    return np.concatenate([groups[keys[i]] for i in draw])\n\n\ndef bootstrap_rho_ci(value: np.ndarray, target: np.ndarray, lineages: np.ndarray, n_boot: int = N_BOOT,\n                     seed: int = SEED, one_sided: bool = False) -> dict:\n    groups = lineage_groups(lineages)\n    if len(groups) < 2:\n        return {\"point\": spearman(value, target), \"ci_lo\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_hi\": float(\"nan\"),\n                \"n_boot\": 0, \"note\": \"fewer than 2 lineages: bootstrap undefined\"}\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    boots = np.empty(n_boot)\n    ndef = 0\n    for b in range(n_boot):\n        idx = lineage_bootstrap_resample_idx(groups, rng)\n        v, t = value[idx], target[idx]\n        if np.std(v) == 0 or np.std(t) == 0 or len(v) < 3:\n            boots[b] = np.nan\n            continue\n        boots[b] = spearman(v, t)\n        ndef += 1\n    valid = boots[~np.isnan(boots)]\n    point = spearman(value, target)\n    if valid.size == 0:\n        return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_hi\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": 0,\n                \"note\": \"all resamples degenerate\"}\n    if one_sided:\n        lo = float(np.percentile(valid, 5))\n        return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo\": lo, \"ci_hi\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": int(valid.size),\n                \"note\": \"one-sided 95% lower bound (5th pct)\"}\n    lo, hi = np.percentile(valid, [2.5, 97.5])\n    return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo\": float(lo), \"ci_hi\": float(hi), \"n_boot\": int(valid.size), \"note\": None}\n\n\ndef bootstrap_partial_rho_ci(value: np.ndarray, target: np.ndarray, covariates: list[np.ndarray],\n                             lineages: np.ndarray, n_boot: int = N_BOOT, seed: int = SEED) -> dict:\n    groups = lineage_groups(lineages)\n    point = partial_spearman(value, target, covariates)\n    if len(groups) < 2:\n        return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo_one_sided\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": 0,\n                \"note\": \"fewer than 2 lineages: bootstrap undefined\"}\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    boots = np.empty(n_boot)\n    for b in range(n_boot):\n        idx = lineage_bootstrap_resample_idx(groups, rng)\n        if len(idx) < len(covariates) + 3:\n            boots[b] = np.nan\n            continue\n        try:\n            boots[b] = partial_spearman(value[idx], target[idx], [c[idx] for c in covariates])\n        except (np.linalg.LinAlgError, ValueError):\n            boots[b] = np.nan\n    valid = boots[~np.isnan(boots)]\n    if valid.size == 0:\n        return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo_one_sided\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": 0, \"note\": \"all resamples degenerate\"}\n    lo = float(np.percentile(valid, 5))\n    return {\"point\": point, \"ci_lo_one_sided\": lo, \"n_boot\": int(valid.size), \"note\": None}\n\n\ndef checkpoint_perm_null(value: np.ndarray, target: np.ndarray, sign: float, n_perm: int = N_PERM,\n                         seed: int = SEED) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Checkpoint-label permutation null for Spearman(value,target): permute which model each target\n    value is attached to (equivalent to permuting rank(target)); one-sided p in the declared direction.\"\"\"\n    n = len(value)\n    if n < 3 or np.std(value) == 0 or np.std(target) == 0:\n        return {\"observed\": float(\"nan\"), \"p_one_sided\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_perm\": 0}\n    rv = _safe_rank(value, \"checkpoint_perm_null:value\")\n    rt = _safe_rank(target, \"checkpoint_perm_null:target\")\n    observed = pearson(rv, rt)\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    perms = np.array([rng.permutation(n) for _ in range(n_perm)])\n    rt_perm = rt[perms]  # (n_perm, n)\n    rv_c = rv - rv.mean()\n    rt_c = rt_perm - rt_perm.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n    num = (rt_c * rv_c).sum(axis=1)\n    den = np.sqrt((rv_c ** 2).sum() * (rt_c ** 2).sum(axis=1))\n    with np.errstate(divide=\"ignore\", invalid=\"ignore\"):\n        null_rho = num / den\n    oriented_obs = sign * observed\n    oriented_null = sign * null_rho\n    n_ge = int(np.sum(oriented_null >= oriented_obs))\n    # (1 + #{null >= obs}) / (1 + n_perm): a permutation p-value is never exactly 0 (Phipson & Smyth 2010)\n    p = float((1 + n_ge) / (1 + n_perm))\n    return {\"observed\": float(observed), \"p_one_sided\": p, \"p_one_sided_uncorrected\": float(n_ge / n_perm),\n            \"n_perm\": n_perm}\n\n\ndef direction_null_fraction(raw_values: np.ndarray, null_p95: np.ndarray, undefined: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    ok = ~undefined & ~np.isnan(null_p95)\n    if ok.sum() == 0:\n        return {\"fraction\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": 0, \"note\": \"no models with both a value and a null_p95\"}\n    frac = float(np.mean(raw_values[ok] > null_p95[ok]))\n    return {\"fraction\": frac, \"n\": int(ok.sum()), \"note\": None}\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# ICC / MDE / margin power\n# =================================================================================================\ndef icc_oneway(target: np.ndarray, lineages: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    df = pd.DataFrame({\"t\": target, \"lin\": lineages})\n    groups = df.groupby(\"lin\")[\"t\"]\n    N = len(df)\n    a = groups.ngroups\n    if a < 2 or N <= a:\n        return {\"icc\": 0.0, \"n_lineages\": a, \"mbar\": N / a if a else float(\"nan\"), \"note\": \"degenerate\"}\n    grand = df[\"t\"].mean()\n    SSB = sum(len(g) * (g.mean() - grand) ** 2 for _, g in groups)\n    SSW = sum(((g - g.mean()) ** 2).sum() for _, g in groups)\n    MSB = SSB / (a - 1)\n    MSW = SSW / (N - a)\n    n_i = groups.size().values\n    k0 = (1.0 / (a - 1)) * (N - (n_i ** 2).sum() / N)\n    denom = MSB + (k0 - 1) * MSW\n    icc_raw = (MSB - MSW) / denom if denom != 0 else 0.0\n    icc = float(np.clip(icc_raw, 0.0, 0.95))\n    return {\"icc\": icc, \"icc_raw\": float(icc_raw), \"n_lineages\": int(a), \"mbar\": float(N / a), \"note\": None}\n\n\ndef mde_from_icc(n: int, icc_info: dict) -> dict:\n    mbar = icc_info[\"mbar\"]\n    icc = icc_info[\"icc\"]\n    deff = 1.0 + (mbar - 1.0) * icc\n    n_eff = n / deff if deff > 0 else float(\"nan\")\n    if not np.isfinite(n_eff) or n_eff <= 3:\n        return {\"deff\": deff, \"n_eff\": n_eff, \"mde_rho\": float(\"nan\"), \"note\": \"n_eff <= 3\"}\n    mde_rho = math.tanh((1.645 + 0.842) / math.sqrt(n_eff - 3))\n    return {\"deff\": float(deff), \"n_eff\": float(n_eff), \"mde_rho\": float(mde_rho), \"note\": None}\n\n\ndef margin_power_sim(lineage_sizes: list[int], icc: float, rho_gap_obs: float, margin: float = MARGIN,\n                     n_sims: int = N_SIMS_POWER, n_boot: int = N_BOOT_POWER, seed: int = SEED,\n                     alpha: float = 0.05) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Monte-Carlo power of the |rho_cand|-|rho_gap| >= margin comparison at the realised n/ICC, assuming\n    a candidate whose true (population) |Spearman| with the target exceeds the observed logit-gap\n    Spearman by exactly `margin`. Detection rule mirrors the real S1 rule: a lineage-cluster bootstrap\n    (n_boot resamples, precomputed index sets reused across all simulated worlds for speed) whose\n    one-sided 5th-percentile lower bound of (|rho_cand|-|rho_gap|) is > 0.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    n_lin = len(lineage_sizes)\n    n = int(sum(lineage_sizes))\n    if n_lin < 2 or n < 4:\n        return {\"power\": float(\"nan\"), \"note\": \"fewer than 2 lineages or n<4: power undefined\"}\n    lineage_of = np.repeat(np.arange(n_lin), lineage_sizes)\n    rho_g = float(np.clip(rho_gap_obs, -0.95, 0.95)) if np.isfinite(rho_gap_obs) else 0.0\n    rho_c = float(np.clip(abs(rho_g) + margin, -0.95, 0.95))\n    icc_c = float(np.clip(icc, 0.0, 0.95))\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    u = rng.normal(0.0, math.sqrt(icc_c), size=(n_sims, n_lin))\n    e = rng.normal(0.0, math.sqrt(max(1.0 - icc_c, 1e-6)), size=(n_sims, n))\n    T = u[:, lineage_of] + e\n    epsG = rng.normal(size=(n_sims, n))\n    epsC = rng.normal(size=(n_sims, n))\n    G = rho_g * T + math.sqrt(max(1.0 - rho_g ** 2, 1e-6)) * epsG\n    C = rho_c * T + math.sqrt(max(1.0 - rho_c ** 2, 1e-6)) * epsC\n    lineage_members = [np.where(lineage_of == g)[0] for g in range(n_lin)]\n    rng_b = np.random.default_rng(seed + 1)\n    boot_idx = []\n    for _ in range(n_boot):\n        samp = rng_b.integers(0, n_lin, size=n_lin)\n        boot_idx.append(np.concatenate([lineage_members[g] for g in samp]))\n    diffs = np.empty((n_boot, n_sims))\n    for bi, idx in enumerate(boot_idx):\n        if len(idx) < 4:\n            diffs[bi] = np.nan\n            continue\n        Tb, Cb, Gb = T[:, idx], C[:, idx], G[:, idx]\n        rT, rC, rG = ordinal_rank_rows(Tb), ordinal_rank_rows(Cb), ordinal_rank_rows(Gb)\n        rhoC, rhoG = row_pearson(rT, rC), row_pearson(rT, rG)\n        diffs[bi] = np.abs(rhoC) - np.abs(rhoG)\n    lower = np.nanpercentile(diffs, 5, axis=0)\n    power = float(np.mean(lower > 0))\n    return {\"power\": power, \"rho_gap_assumed\": rho_g, \"rho_cand_assumed\": rho_c, \"n\": n, \"n_lineages\": n_lin,\n            \"n_sims\": n_sims, \"n_boot\": n_boot, \"alpha\": alpha, \"seconds\": round(time.perf_counter() - t0, 2)}\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# LOFO\n# =================================================================================================\ndef lofo_spearman(target: np.ndarray, value: np.ndarray, families: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    preds = np.full(len(target), np.nan)\n    for fam in np.unique(families):\n        train = families != fam\n        test = families == fam\n        if train.sum() < 2:\n            continue\n        x, y = value[train], target[train]\n        if np.std(x) == 0:\n            preds[test] = y.mean()\n        else:\n            slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)\n            preds[test] = intercept + slope * value[test]\n    ok = ~np.isnan(preds)\n    if ok.sum() < 3:\n        return {\"score\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": int(ok.sum())}\n    return {\"score\": spearman(target[ok], preds[ok]), \"n\": int(ok.sum())}\n\n\ndef lofo_family_only(target: np.ndarray, families: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    preds = np.full(len(target), np.nan)\n    for fam in np.unique(families):\n        train = families != fam\n        test = families == fam\n        if train.sum() < 1:\n            continue\n        preds[test] = target[train].mean()\n    ok = ~np.isnan(preds)\n    if ok.sum() < 3:\n        return {\"score\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": int(ok.sum())}\n    return {\"score\": spearman(target[ok], preds[ok]), \"n\": int(ok.sum())}\n\n\n# =================================================================================================\n# Per-candidate analysis\n# =================================================================================================\ndef get_raw_series(df: pd.DataFrame, cid: str, variant: str = \"primary\") -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, list]:\n    vals, unds, reas = [], [], []\n    for cd in df[\"candidates\"]:\n        c = (cd or {}).get(cid, {})\n        v, u, r = extract_variant(c, variant)\n        vals.append(v)\n        unds.append(u)\n        reas.append(r)\n    raw = np.array([np.nan if v is None else float(v) for v in vals], dtype=np.float64)\n    und = np.array(unds, dtype=bool) | np.isnan(raw)\n    return raw, und, reas\n\n\ndef oracle_series(df: pd.DataFrame, base_cid: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, list]:\n    vals, unds, reas = [], [], []\n    for cd in df[\"candidates\"]:\n        c = (cd or {}).get(base_cid, {})\n        v = c.get(\"oracle\")\n        r = c.get(\"oracle_reason\")\n        vals.append(v)\n        unds.append(v is None)\n        reas.append(r)\n    raw = np.array([np.nan if v is None else float(v) for v in vals], dtype=np.float64)\n    und = np.array(unds, dtype=bool) | np.isnan(raw)\n    return raw, und, reas\n\n\ndef analyse_candidate(cid: str, gdf: pd.DataFrame, gdf[\"family\"].to_numpy()\n    lineages = gdf[\"lineage\"].to_numpy()\n    n_families = len(np.unique(families))\n    n_lineages = len(np.unique(lineages))\n    log_np = safe_log10(gdf[\"n_params\"].fillna(gdf[\"n_params\"].median()).to_numpy())\n    logit_gap_raw, lg_und, _ = get_raw_series(gdf, \"logit_gap\", \"primary\")\n    # scipy.stats.rankdata propagates NaN to the WHOLE output if a single element is NaN, so the\n    # logit_gap covariate used in every other candidate's partial rho must never contain a NaN:\n    # apply the same worst-value rule used for S1/S3 to it before it is used as a covariate.\n    logit_gap_cov = apply_worst_value_rule(logit_gap_raw, lg_und, ORIENT[\"logit_gap\"])\n\n    if is_oracle:\n        base_cid = cid.replace(\"_oracle\", \"\")\n        raw, und, reasons = oracle_series(gdf, base_cid)\n    else:\n        raw, und, reasons = get_raw_series(gdf, cid, \"primary\")\n    n_undefined = int(und.sum())\n\n    out: dict[str, Any] = {\"definition\": DEFINITION.get(cid, \"\"), \"orientation\": (\"two-sided\" if sign is None\n                           else (\"+\" if sign > 0 else \"-\")), \"role\": role, \"n\": n, \"n_families\": n_families,\n                           \"n_lineages\": n_lineages, \"n_undefined\": n_undefined,\n                           \"undefined_fraction\": n_undefined / n if n else float(\"nan\"),\n                           \"flag_undefined_majority\": bool(n > 0 and n_undefined > n / 2)}\n\n    if n < N_FLOOR:\n        out[\"not_detectable_at_this_n\"] = True\n        out[\"mde\"] = shared_mde\n        out[\"S1\"] = {\"pass\": False, \"reason\": f\"not detectable at this n (n={n} < floor {N_FLOOR}); \"\n                     f\"MDE_rho={shared_mde.get('mde_rho')}\"}\n        for s in (\"S2\", \"S3\", \"S4\", \"S5\", \"S6\"):\n            out[s] = {\"pass\": False, \"reason\": \"not detectable at this n\"}\n        out[\"rho\"] = {}\n        return out\n    out[\"not_detectable_at_this_n\"] = False\n\n    # --- worst-value-substituted oriented series (used ONLY for S1 / S3, per PREREG H5 rule) ---\n    oriented_wv = apply_worst_value_rule(raw, und, sign)\n\n    rho_by_target: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    for tgt_name in TARGETS:\n        tgt = gdf[tgt_name].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)\n        ok = ~np.isnan(tgt) & ~und\n        rho_ckpt = spearman(raw[ok], tgt[ok]) if ok.sum() >= 3 else float(\"nan\")\n        ci = bootstrap_rho_ci(raw[ok], tgt[ok], lineages[ok]) \\\n            if ok.sum() >= 3 else {\"point\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_lo\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_hi\": float(\"nan\"),\n                                    \"n_boot\": 0, \"note\": \"n<3\"}\n        # family means\n        fam_df = pd.DataFrame({\"v\": raw, \"t\": tgt, \"f\": families, \"ok\": ok})\n        fam_df = fam_df[fam_df[\"ok\"]]\n        fam_means = fam_df.groupby(\"f\").agg(v=(\"v\", \"mean\"), t=(\"t\", \"mean\"))\n        rho_family = spearman(fam_means[\"v\"].to_numpy(), fam_means[\"t\"].to_numpy()) if len(fam_means) >= 3 \\\n            else float(\"nan\")\n        rho_by_target[tgt_name] = {\n            \"rho_ckpt\": rho_ckpt, \"rho_ckpt_boot\": ci, \"n_ckpt\": int(ok.sum()),\n            \"rho_family\": rho_family, \"n_families_used\": int(len(fam_means)),\n        }\n    out[\"rho\"] = rho_by_target\n\n    # --- partial rho (BALANCED only, primary) ---\n    tgt = gdf[PRIMARY_TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)\n    ok = ~np.isnan(tgt) & ~und\n    ok_wv = ~np.isnan(tgt)  # S1 keeps undefined models at the worst oriented panel value (PREREG H5 rule)\n    if cid == \"logit_gap\":\n        covs = [log_np[ok]]\n        cov_desc = \"log10(n_params) only\"\n    else:\n        covs = [logit_gap_cov[ok], log_np[ok]]\n        cov_desc = \"logit_gap, log10(n_params)\"\n    if ok_wv.sum() >= 5 and sign is not None and np.isfinite(oriented_wv[ok_wv]).all():\n        covs_wv = ([log_np[ok_wv]] if cid == \"logit_gap\" else [logit_gap_cov[ok_wv], log_np[ok_wv]])\n        partial_pt = partial_spearman(oriented_wv[ok_wv], tgt[ok_wv], covs_wv)\n        boot = bootstrap_partial_rho_ci(oriented_wv[ok_wv], tgt[ok_wv], covs_wv, lineages[ok_wv])\n    elif ok.sum() >= 5:\n        partial_pt = partial_spearman(raw[ok], tgt[ok], covs)\n        boot = bootstrap_partial_rho_ci(raw[ok], tgt[ok], covs, lineages[ok])\n    else:\n        partial_pt, boot = float(\"nan\"), {\"point\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_lo_one_sided\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": 0}\n    out[\"partial_rho\"] = {\"covariates\": cov_desc, \"point\": partial_pt, \"boot\": boot,\n                          \"n_worst_value_substituted\": (int(und[ok_wv].sum()) if (ok_wv.sum() >= 5 and sign is not None)\n                                                        else 0)}\n\n    # --- partial rho, PRODUCT (secondary target; SPEC step 4 asks for partial rho \"under BOTH targets\";\n    # reported for completeness only -- S1 remains gated on BALANCED alone per PREREG, never on this) ---\n    tgt_p = gdf[\"PRODUCT\"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)\n    ok_p = ~np.isnan(tgt_p) & ~und\n    ok_wv_p = ~np.isnan(tgt_p)\n    if ok_wv_p.sum() >= 5 and sign is not None and np.isfinite(oriented_wv[ok_wv_p]).all():\n        covs_wv_p = ([log_np[ok_wv_p]] if cid == \"logit_gap\" else [logit_gap_cov[ok_wv_p], log_np[ok_wv_p]])\n        partial_pt_p = partial_spearman(oriented_wv[ok_wv_p], tgt_p[ok_wv_p], covs_wv_p)\n        boot_p = bootstrap_partial_rho_ci(oriented_wv[ok_wv_p], tgt_p[ok_wv_p], covs_wv_p, lineages[ok_wv_p])\n    elif ok_p.sum() >= 5:\n        covs_p = [log_np[ok_p]] if cid == \"logit_gap\" else [logit_gap_cov[ok_p], log_np[ok_p]]\n        partial_pt_p = partial_spearman(raw[ok_p], tgt_p[ok_p], covs_p)\n        boot_p = bootstrap_partial_rho_ci(raw[ok_p], tgt_p[ok_p], covs_p, lineages[ok_p])\n    else:\n        partial_pt_p, boot_p = float(\"nan\"), {\"point\": float(\"nan\"), \"ci_lo_one_sided\": float(\"nan\"), \"n_boot\": 0}\n    out[\"partial_rho_product\"] = {\"covariates\": cov_desc, \"point\": partial_pt_p, \"boot\": boot_p,\n                                   \"note\": \"descriptive/secondary only; never gates S1 (PREREG S1 is BALANCED-only)\"}\n\n    # --- LOFO ---\n    lofo_val = lofo_spearman(tgt[ok], raw[ok], families[ok]) if ok.sum() >= 5 else {\"score\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": 0}\n    lofo_fam = lofo_family_only(tgt[ok], families[ok]) if ok.sum() >= 5 else {\"score\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": 0}\n    lofo_size = lofo_spearman(tgt[ok], log_np[ok], families[ok]) if ok.sum() >= 5 else {\"score\": float(\"nan\"), \"n\": 0}\n    out[\"lofo\"] = {\"candidate\": lofo_val, \"family_only\": lofo_fam, \"size_only\": lofo_size}\n\n    # --- MDE / margin (shared panel-level numbers, attached per candidate for convenience) ---\n    out[\"mde\"] = shared_mde\n    margin_val = abs(rho_by_target[PRIMARY_TARGET][\"rho_ckpt\"]) - rho_gap_balanced_abs \\\n        if np.isfinite(rho_by_target[PRIMARY_TARGET][\"rho_ckpt\"]) else float(\"nan\")\n    out[\"margin_0.15_over_logit_gap\"] = {\"value\": margin_val, \"descriptive_only\": True,\n                                          \"mde_rho\": shared_mde.get(\"mde_rho\"), \"power_sim\": shared_power}\n\n    # =========================================================== S1..S6\n    S: dict[str, dict] = {}\n    if sign is None:\n        S[\"S1\"] = {\"pass\": False, \"reason\": f\"{cid} S1-S6\"}\n        out[\"S1\"], out[\"S2\"], out[\"S3\"], out[\"S4\"], out[\"S5\"], out[\"S6\"] = (S[\"S1\"], S[\"S2\"], S[\"S3\"], S[\"S4\"],\n {\"pass\": s1_pass, \"reason\": f\"one-sided 95% lineage-bootstrap lower bound of oriented partial rho \"\n               f\"({cov_desc}) = {lo1:.4f} (point={partial_pt:.4f}, n_boot={boot.get('n_boot')})\"\n               if np.isfinite(lo1) else \"partial-rho bootstrap degenerate (too few valid resamples)\"}\n\n    # S2\n    # NB: pass the UN-oriented raw values here (not the S1/S3 worst-value substitution -- PREREG limits that to S1/S3).\n    perm = checkpoint_perm_null(raw[ok], tgt[ok], sign)\n    s2a_pass = bool(np.isfinite(perm[\"p_one_sided\"]) and perm[\"p_one_sided\"] < 0.05)\n    if cid in NULL_P95_IDS:\n        null_raw, _, _ = get_raw_series(gdf, cid, \"null_p95\")\n        frac_info = direction_null_fraction(raw, null_raw, und)\n        s2b_pass = bool(np.isfinite(frac_info[\"fraction\"]) and frac_info[\"fraction\"] >= 0.60)\n        s2_pass = s2a_pass and s2b_pass\n        s2_reason = (f\"(a) perm p_one_sided={perm['p_one_sided']:.4f} ({'pass' if s2a_pass else 'fail'}) AND \"\n                     f\"(b) direction-null: value>null_p95 on {frac_info['fraction']:.2f} of {frac_info['n']} \"\n                     f\"models ({'pass' if s2b_pass else 'fail'}, need >=0.60)\")\n    else:\n        s2_pass = s2a_pass\n        s2_reason = (f\"no direction null defined for {cid}; S2 decided on (a) alone: perm \"\n                     f\"p_one_sided={perm['p_one_sided']:.4f} ({'pass' if s2a_pass else 'fail'})\")\n    S[\"S2\"] = {\"pass\": s2_pass, \"reason\": s2_reason}\n\n    # S3\n    skip_pole_mask = None\n    if cid == \"C9\" and \"c9_true_patch_pole_missing\" in gdf.columns:\n        miss = gdf[\"c9_true_patch_pole_missing\"].tolist()\n        skip_pole_mask = {pv: np.array([bool(m.get(pv)) for m in miss]) for pv in (\"pole_refuse\", \"pole_comply\")}\n    S[\"S3\"] = s3_check(cid, sign, gdf, oriented_wv, skip_pole_mask=skip_pole_mask)\n\n    # S4\n    rc = rho_by_target[PRIMARY_TARGET][\"rho_ckpt\"]\n    rf = rho_by_target[PRIMARY_TARGET][\"rho_family\"]\n    if np.isfinite(rc) and np.isfinite(rf) and rc != 0 and rf != 0:\n        s4_pass = bool(np.sign(rc) == np.sign(rf))\n        s4_reason = f\"sign(rho_ckpt)={np.sign(rc):+.0f} vs sign(rho_family)={np.sign(rf):+.0f}\"\n    else:\n        s4_pass = False\n        s4_reason = f\"rho_ckpt={rc}, rho_family={rf}: one or both undefined/zero\"\n    S[\"S4\"] = {\"pass\": s4_pass, \"reason\": s4_reason}\n\n    # S5\n    S[\"S5\"] = {\"pass\": False, \"reason\": \"not measurable on CPU (LIVE_TIER_NO_CUDA)\"}\n\n    # S6\n    lv, lfv, lsv = lofo_val[\"score\"], lofo_fam[\"score\"], lofo_size[\"score\"]\n    if all(np.isfinite(x) for x in (lv, lfv, lsv)):\n        s6_pass = bool(lv > lfv and lv > lsv)\n        s6_reason = f\"LOFO={lv:.4f} vs family_only={lfv:.4f}, size_only={lsv:.4f}\"\n    else:\n        s6_pass = False\n        s6_reason = f\"LOFO not computable (LOFO={lv}, family_only={lfv}, size_only={lsv})\"\n    S[\"S6\"] = {\"pass\": s6_pass, \"reason\": s6_reason}\n\n    if role == \"COMPARATOR\" or \"COMPARATOR\" in role:\n        for k in S:\n            S[k][\"pass\"] = False\n            S[k][\"reason\"] = \"COMPARATOR: never passes into the shipped set. \" + S[k][\"reason\"]\n\n    out[\"S1\"], out[\"S2\"], out[\"S3\"], out[\"S4\"], out[\"S5\"], out[\"S6\"] = (S[\"S1\"], S[\"S2\"], S[\"S3\"], S[\"S4\"],\n                                                                         S[\"S5\"], S[\"S6\"])\n    return out\n\n\ndef s3_check(cid: str, sign: float, gdf: pd.DataFrame, oriented_wv: np.ndarray,\n            skip_pole_mask: dict[str, np.ndarray] | None = None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Blanket refusers must score worse than the honest instruct model sharing their lineage;\n    each honest instruct model's own wrapped poles must score worse than its own plain value.\n    skip_pole_mask: {pv: bool array over gdf} of pole entries to EXCLUDE from the check (not\n    worst-valued) -- used for C9 under ATP_UNRELIABLE when true_patch_pole_* was not measured for\n    that model (a missing measurement, not a measured-but-undefined candidate value).\"\"\"\n    idx_of_repo = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(gdf[\"repo\"].to_numpy())}\n    classes = gdf[\"class\"].to_numpy()\n    lineages = gdf[\"lineage\"].to_numpy()\n    repos = gdf[\"repo\"].to_numpy()\n\n    checks = []\n    # blanket refusers vs their lineage's honest instruct model\n    instruct_by_lineage = {lineages[i]: repos[i] for i in range(len(gdf)) if classes[i] == \"instruct\"}\n    for i in range(len(gdf)):\n        if classes[i] != \"blanket_refuser\":\n            continue\n        base_repo = instruct_by_lineage.get(lineages[i])\n        if base_repo is None:\n            continue\n        j = idx_of_repo[base_repo]\n        checks.append((\"blanket_refuser\", repos[i], base_repo, oriented_wv[i] < oriented_wv[j]))\n\n    # wrapped poles of each honest instruct model vs its own plain value\n    pole_raw = {}\n    unmeasured = []\n    for pv in (\"pole_refuse\", \"pole_comply\"):\n        raw, und, _ = get_raw_series(gdf, cid, pv)\n        if (~und).sum() == 0 and skip_pole_mask is None:  # C9 ATP_UNRELIABLE path keeps its own exclusion rule\n            # AUDIT3 fix: no pole value measured anywhere on the panel (e.g. oracle rows, which have no\n            # pole-condition oracle read). Previously worst_value() returned its -1e9 sentinel for every\n            # model, so every pole check passed trivially. There is no 'worst observed panel value' to\n            # substitute, so the pole half of S3 is not assessable.\n            unmeasured.append(pv)\n        oriented = apply_worst_value_rule(raw, und, sign)\n        pole_raw[pv] = oriented\n    if unmeasured:\n        return {\"pass\": False, \"assessable\": False, \"n_checks\": 0,\n                \"reason\": f\"S3 not assessable: {'/'.join(unmeasured)} values not measured for {cid} on any \"\n                          f\"panel model (S3 requires both wrapped poles; #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""write_env.py -- record the compute environment of the CURRENT session into env.json (plan step 0).

env.json keeps one entry per session, because this artifact ran across four pods:
  sessions 1-3 were CPU-only (LIVE_TIER_NO_CUDA), and session 4 got an NVIDIA L4.
The top-level keys describe the session that produced the final rows/ (the latest session).
Re-running the script replaces the entry for the same session id instead of appending a duplicate.

Usage: venv_gpu/bin/python write_env.py --session 4 [--note "..."]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def cgroup_cpus() -> float | None:
    for p, per in (("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max", None), ("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_quota_us",
                                                        "/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.cfs_period_us")):
        try:
            if per is None:
                q, prd = Path(p).read_text().split()
                if q != "max":
                    return int(q) / int(prd)
            else:
                q = int(Path(p).read_text())
                if q > 0:
                    return q / int(Path(per).read_text())
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    return None


def cgroup_mem_gb() -> float | None:
    for p in ("/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max", "/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes"):
        try:
            v = Path(p).read_text().strip()
            if v != "max" and int(v) < 1 << 60:
                return int(v) / 1e9
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
    return None


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--session", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--note", default="")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    import torch
    import transformers
    cuda = torch.cuda.is_available()
    ent = {
        "session": a.session,
        "start_time_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "cuda": cuda,
        "device_name": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if cuda else None,
        "vram_total_gb": round(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 1e9, 2) if cuda else None,
        "vram_cap_gb": 9.3 if cuda else None,
        "torch": torch.__version__, "torch_cuda": torch.version.cuda, "transformers": transformers.__version__,
        "python": platform.python_version(),
        "nproc_affinity": len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
        "cgroup_cpus": cgroup_cpus(),
        "ram_limit_gb_cgroup": cgroup_mem_gb(),
        "git_sha": None,
        "note": a.note,
    }
    try:
        ent["nvidia_smi"] = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total",
                                            "--format=csv,noheader"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                           timeout=20).stdout.strip() or None
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        ent["nvidia_smi"] = None
    p = WS / "env.json"
    env = json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {"sessions": []}
    env["sessions"] = [s for s in env.get("sessions", []) if s.get("session") != a.session] + [ent]
    env["sessions"].sort(key=lambda s: s["session"])
    latest = env["sessions"][-1]
    env.update({k: v for k, v in latest.items() if k != "note"})
    tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(env, indent=1))
    os.replace(tmp, p)
    print(json.dumps(latest, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

(7) The C1/C2 oracle rows now need >=2 judged items per class, the same gate as C16_oracle; C16_oracle's direction is in-sample (stated in each row). EVERY row was re-measured with v2 code. The v1 rows and code are kept in scratch/rows_v1_pre_review/ and scratch/code_v1_pre_review/ for provenance. File: /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_4/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1/s4_bookkeeping.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""s4_bookkeeping.py -- session-4 bookkeeping (idempotent; safe to re-run after every GPU panel stage).

Session 4 started after the third pod restart on a new pod that HAS a GPU (NVIDIA L4, 23 GB). The whole panel
is re-measured on CUDA into rows/, and the session-3 CPU rows are kept in scratch/rows_cpu_v3/.

1. skips.json: a repo with a rows/<slug>.json row is MEASURED, so any skip entry for it (e.g. the session-1
   NOT_IN_CPU_SUBPANEL entries) moves to skips_superseded.json with the time and the superseding row.
2. DEVIATIONS.json: marks the CPU-era entries SUPERSEDED for the final rows (their text is kept for provenance,
   because it still describes scratch/rows_cpu_v3/), appends the third restart to POD_RESTART_RESUME, and
   adds or refreshes the session-4 entries. The texts are regenerated from the rows on disk.
3. Coverage: every non-sealed chat/base panel repo must be in rows/ or skips.json; prints the gaps.

Usage: venv_live/bin/python s4_bookkeeping.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = Path("/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_3/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1")
ANCHORS = ["Qwen/Qwen3-4B", "Qwen/Qwen3-4B-SafeRL", "DreamFast/qwen3-4b-heretic", "mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated"]
BASE = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base"
SUPERSEDED_TAG = "SUPERSEDED in session 4"


def slug(repo: str) -> str:
    return repo.replace("/", "__")


def atomic_write(p: Path, obj) -> None:
    tmp = p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=1))
    os.replace(tmp, p)


def load_rows(d: Path) -> dict[str, dict]:
    out = {}
    for p in sorted(d.glob("*.json")):
        r = json.loads(p.read_text())
        out[r["repo"]] = r
    return out


def upsert(devs: list[dict], code: str, detail: str, affected: list[str]) -> None:
    for d in devs:
        if d.get("code") == code:
            d["detail"], d["affected_repos"] = detail, affected
            return
    devs.append({"code": code, "detail": detail, "affected_repos": affected})


def supersede(devs: list[dict], code: str, why: str) -> None:
    for d in devs:
        if d.get("code") == code and not d["detail"].startswith(SUPERSEDED_TAG):
            d["detail"] = f"{SUPERSEDED_TAG} ({why}). Earlier text, kept for provenance: " + d["detail"]


def dev(r: dict) -> str:
    return (r.get("compute") or {}).get("device", "cpu")


def main() -> None:
    rows = load_rows(WS / "rows")
    cpu_rows = load_rows(WS / "scratch" / "rows_cpu_v3") if (WS / "scratch" / "rows_cpu_v3").exists() else {}
    panel = json.loads((DATA / "panel.json").read_text())["rows"]
    labels = json.loads((WS / "labels_map.json").read_text())["rows"]
    gpu = {k: r for k, r in rows.items() if dev(r) == "cuda"}
    non_gpu = sorted(k for k, r in rows.items() if dev(r) != "cuda")

    # ---- 1. skips
    skips = json.loads((WS / "skips.json").read_text()) if (WS / "skips.json").exists() else []
    sup_p = WS / "skips_superseded.json"
    superseded = json.loads(sup_p.read_text()) if sup_p.exists() else []
    keep = []
    for s in skips:
        if s["repo"] in rows:
            s2 = dict(s)
            s2["superseded_utc"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
            s2["superseded_by"] = f"rows/{slug(s['repo'])}.json ({dev(rows[s['repo']])})"
            if not any(x["repo"] == s["repo"] and x.get("code") == s.get("code") for x in superseded):
                superseded.append(s2)
        else:
            keep.append(s)
    atomic_write(WS / "skips.json", keep)
    atomic_write(sup_p, superseded)

    # ---- 2. deviations
    devs = json.loads((WS / "DEVIATIONS.json").read_text())
    why_gpu = "the final rows/ were re-measured on an NVIDIA L4 GPU; see GPU_SESSION4_FULL_PANEL"
    for code in ("LIVE_TIER_NO_CUDA", "CPU_DTYPE_BF16_ALL", "HARDWARE_SESSION3", "ANCHOR_QUARTET_FULL_ON_CPU",
                 "PANEL_EXTENDED_UNGRADED_EXTRAS"):
        supersede(devs, code, why_gpu + "; the text still describes the CPU rows in scratch/rows_cpu_v3/")
    for d in devs:
        if d.get("code") == "ANCHOR_QUARTET_LITE" and "session 4" not in d["detail"]:
            d["detail"] = ("Session 4: the anchor quartet was measured on the GPU in full mode with the PREREG caps; no "
                           "row carries ANCHOR_LITE. " + d["detail"])
        if d.get("code") == "POD_RESTART_RESUME" and "third pod restart" not in d["detail"]:
            d["detail"] += (" A third pod restart (~18:17-18:23 UTC) killed the session-3 v3 driver after 12 v3 CPU rows. "
                            "Session 4 (18:24 UTC) started on a new pod with an NVIDIA L4 GPU and re-measured the whole "
                            "panel on CUDA (GPU_SESSION4_FULL_PANEL); the 12 session-3 CPU rows were moved to "
                            "scratch/rows_cpu_v3/.")
    n_rand = sorted({(r.get("compute") or {}).get("n_rand") for r in gpu.values()} - {None})
    peaks = [(r.get("compute") or {}).get("vram_peak_gb") for r in gpu.values()]
    peaks = [p for p in peaks if isinstance(p, (int, float))]
    chunked = sorted(k for k, r in gpu.items() if any(isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("code") == "GRAD_CHUNKED"
                                                      for f in (r.get("flags") or [])))
    graded_gpu = sorted(k for k in gpu if (labels.get(k) or {}).get("BALANCED") is not None)
    upsert(devs, "GPU_SESSION4_FULL_PANEL",
           "Session 4 ran on a new pod with an NVIDIA L4 (23 GB; cgroup 15.3 CPUs / 71 GB RAM), after the third pod "
           "restart. It built the CUDA venv venv_gpu (torch 2.14.0 CUDA build, transformers 4.57.6; same versions as "
           "venv_live apart from the CUDA build). It made method.py/live_lib.py device-agnostic with device plumbing "
           "only: model and batch on the device, .cpu() before numpy, hook vectors on the hidden state's device, "
           "torch.cuda.synchronize() in the per-block timers, set_per_process_memory_fraction(9.3/total), no RLIMIT_AS "
           "under CUDA, and a GRAD_CHUNKED halving fallback for the backward pass. Candidate definitions, directions, "
           "folds, seeds, bands, prompts and judge calls are unchanged. "
           f"Measured on the GPU: {len(gpu)} rows ({len(graded_gpu)} graded), in full mode with the PREREG time caps. "
           f"PREREG's pre-declared GPU-branch constants apply: {n_rand or '[20]'} anisotropy-matched random "
           "directions (PREREG n_gpu = 20; its 'used': 8 and compute_mode.cuda = false describe the CPU state when the "
           "file was hashed at 15:59:59Z, and the file is unchanged), and all 5 C16 alphas in every variant, because "
           "the 3-alpha variant grid was a CPU-only budget cut. "
           f"VRAM peak: max {max(peaks):.2f} GB over {len(peaks)} rows (cap 9.3 GB). " if peaks else
           "VRAM peak: not yet available. ")
    d_last = next(d for d in devs if d["code"] == "GPU_SESSION4_FULL_PANEL")
    d_last["detail"] += (f"The backward pass fell back to chunks on: {chunked or 'none'}. "
                         f"Rows not measured on CUDA: {non_gpu or 'none'}. S5 (<120 s per 4B model on the GPU, "
                         "excluding load) is measurable in this session. The 12 CPU rows of session 3 "
                         f"({len(cpu_rows)} files in scratch/rows_cpu_v3/) are compared with their GPU re-measurement "
                         "in candidates_live.json 'cross_hardware'. That comparison is descriptive only.")
    d_last["affected_repos"] = sorted(gpu)
    upsert(devs, "ROSI_ARM_CPU_FP32",
           "The ROSI 128-token side arm (rosi128.py, rosi_128tok.json) ran in sessions 1-2 on CPU in float32 "
           "(the plan's CPU rule), not in bf16 on a GPU. Session 4 does not re-run it: fp32 is the more exact path, "
           "the 128-token generations and their paid grades are final, and the arm does not depend on the panel.",
           ["Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"])
    atomic_write(WS / "DEVIATIONS.json", devs)

    # ---- 3. coverage
    skip_repos = {s["repo"] for s in keep}
    gaps = [pr["repo"] for pr in panel if not pr.get("sealed") and pr.get("stratum") in ("chat", "base")
            and pr["repo"] not in rows and pr["repo"] not in skip_repos]
    print(json.dumps({"rows": len(rows), "gpu_rows": len(gpu), "graded_gpu_rows": len(graded_gpu),
                      "anchors_measured": [a for a in ANCHORS if a in rows], "base_measured": BASE in rows,
                      "non_gpu_rows": non_gpu, "skips_active": keep, "skips_superseded": len(superseded),
                      "grad_chunked": chunked, "vram_peak_max_gb": max(peaks) if peaks else None,
                      "coverage_gaps": gaps}, indent=1))
    if gaps:
        print("COVERAGE GAPS: these panel repos are neither in rows/ nor in skips.json (still queued?)", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

NEW: def row_compute(row: dict) -> dict:
    """row['compute'] is written by GPU-tier method.py; older CPU rows never set the key at all, so a
    missing key means CPU (per spec). Normalise so every consumer sees a dict with at least 'device'."""
    c = row.get("compute") or {}
    if "device" not in c:
        c = {**c, "device": "cpu"}
    return c


def joined_frame(rows: list[dict], labels: dict[str, dict]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """One row per model with label-sourced repo/family/lineage/class/stratum/status/BALANCED/PRODUCT,
    plus n_params/candidates/etc. from the row file itself."""
    recs = []
    for row in rows:
        repo = row.get("repo")
        lab = labels.get(repo)
        if lab is None:
            logger.warning(f"{repo}: not in labels_map.json -- falling back to the row's own copy")
            lab = {"BALANCED": row.get("BALANCED"), "PRODUCT": row.get("PRODUCT"), "family": row.get("family"),
                   "lineage": row.get("lineage"), "class": row.get("class"), "stratum": row.get("stratum"),
                   "status": "graded" if row.get("graded") else "unknown"}
        compute = row_compute(row)
        recs.append({
            "repo": repo, "resolved_sha": row.get("resolved_sha"),
            "family": lab.get("family"), "lineage": lab.get("lineage"), "class": lab.get("class"),
            "stratum": lab.get("stratum"), "label_status": lab.get("status"),
            "BALANCED": lab.get("BALANCED"), "PRODUCT": lab.get("PRODUCT"),
            "n_params": row.get("n_params"), "row_status": row.get("status"),
            "screen16_file_sha256": row.get("screen16_file_sha256"), "prereg_hash": row.get("prereg_hash"),
            "candidate_seconds": row.get("candidate_seconds", {}), "candidates": row.get("candidates", {}),
            "oracle": row.get("oracle", {}), "offset_control": row.get("offset_control"),
            "C1_linear_range_eps": row.get("C1_linear_range_eps"),
            "C1_linearity": row.get("C1_linearity"),
            "C1_nonlinear_at_primary": row.get("C1_nonlinear_at_primary"),
            "wall_s": row.get("wall_s"),
            "lite": any(f_.get("code") == "ANCHOR_LITE" for f_ in (row.get("flags") or [])),
            "compute": compute, "device": compute.get("device", "cpu"),
            "device_name": compute.get("device_name"), "n_rand": compute.get("n_rand"),
            "total_after_load_s": (row.get("timing") or {}).get("total_after_load_s"),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame.from_records(recs)

File: /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_4/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1/analyze_live.py
OLD: # =================================================================================================
# ICC / MDE / margin power
# =================================================================================================
NEW: # =================================================================================================
# S5 ("k <= 16 prompts and < 120 s per 4B model on the GPU, excluding load")
# =================================================================================================
def gpu_4b_chat_rows(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Every chat row measured with device=='cuda' and n_params >= S5_N_PARAMS_4B_FLOOR -- the S5
    reference set. Uses the FULL panel (graded + ungraded), like the C9 AtP-reliability check: S5 is a
    measurement-quality gate, not a correlation, so an ungraded ~4B GPU row still counts."""
    if "stratum" not in df.columns or len(df) == 0:
        return df.iloc[0:0]
    chat = df[df["stratum"] == "chat"]
    dev = chat["device"] if "device" in chat.columns else pd.Series(["cpu"] * len(chat), index=chat.index)
    npar = pd.to_numeric(chat["n_params"], errors="coerce")
    return chat[(dev == "cuda") & (npar >= S5_N_PARAMS_4B_FLOOR)]


def s5_k_prompts(prereg: dict) -> int:
    """k = number of prompts in the primary (non-k8) SCREEN16 item set = 2 * n_pair_ids (harmful + twin).
    Read from PREREG.json rather than hard-coded, so a future re-registration is picked up automatically."""
    ids = ((prereg.get("screen16") or {}).get("pair_ids")) or []
    return 2 * len(ids) if ids else 16  # 16 is PREREG's own documented fallback (8 pairs), never invented


def s5_check(cid: str, rows4b: pd.DataFrame, k_prompts: int) -> dict:
    """S5 = k <= 16 prompts AND < 120s per ~4B model on the GPU (excluding load), assessed ONLY on cuda
    rows. Fails with a distinct, honest reason when there is no 4B GPU row at all, vs. when there is one
    but this candidate's seconds were never recorded, vs. when the recorded seconds exceed the cap."""
    n_rows = int(len(rows4b))
    if n_rows == 0:
        return {"pass": False, "assessable": False, "n_4B_gpu_rows": 0, "k_prompts": k_prompts,
                "reason": "not measurable (no ~4B model measured on GPU)"}
    k_ok = bool(k_prompts <= 16)
    secs, missing = [], []
    for _, r in rows4b.iterrows():
        v = (r["candidate_seconds"] or {}).get(cid)
        (secs if v is not None else missing).append(r["repo"] if v is None else float(v))
    if not secs:
        return {"pass": False, "assessable": False, "n_4B_gpu_rows": n_rows, "k_prompts": k_prompts,
                "k_le_16": k_ok, "reason": f"not assessable: candidate_seconds['{cid}'] was not recorded on "
                f"any of the {n_rows} ~4B GPU row(s) ({', '.join(missing)})"}
    max_s, median_s = float(np.max(secs)), float(np.median(secs))
    all_under = bool(max_s < S5_TIME_LIMIT_S)
    s5_pass = bool(k_ok and all_under and not missing)
    reason = (f"k={k_prompts}<=16: {'ok' if k_ok else 'FAIL'}; {len(secs)}/{n_rows} ~4B GPU row(s) timed for "
              f"{cid}: max={max_s:.1f}s, median={median_s:.1f}s (limit <{S5_TIME_LIMIT_S:.0f}s, excluding "
              "load)" + (f"; {cid} seconds MISSING on {len(missing)}/{n_rows}: {', '.join(missing)}"
                         if missing else ""))
    return {"pass": s5_pass, "assessable": True, "n_4B_gpu_rows": n_rows, "n_timed": len(secs),
            "max_s": max_s, "median_s": median_s, "k_prompts": k_prompts, "k_le_16": k_ok,
            "missing_seconds_repos": missing, "reason": reason}


def s5_4b_model_totals(rows4b: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """Descriptive line (not S1-S6): each ~4B GPU model's TOTAL measurement seconds excluding load (the
    whole live screen, timing['total_after_load_s']) against the 120s-per-candidate cap it is not the
    same quantity as -- reported for context, never gating."""
    models = []
    for _, r in rows4b.iterrows():
        tot = r.get("total_after_load_s")
        models.append({"repo": r["repo"], "total_after_load_s": tot,
                       "under_120s": (tot is not None and math.isfinite(float(tot)) and float(tot) < 120.0)
                       if tot is not None else None})
    return {"n_4B_gpu_rows": int(len(rows4b)), "models": models, "descriptive_only": True,
            "note": "whole live-screen wall time per ~4B GPU model, excluding load, vs. 120s; this is NOT "
                    "the per-candidate S5 quantity (S5 is per-candidate candidate_seconds), just context"}


# =================================================================================================
# ICC / MDE / margin power
# =================================================================================================
```

        out[cid] = by_bucket

NEW: def _size_bucket(x: float) -> str:
    """Plan's buckets <1B/1-2B/3-4B, PLUS a 2-3B bucket (bug fix: the original bucketing had no [2e9,3e9)
    arm, so those models silently fell into a bucket mislabelled '3-4B')."""
    if not np.isfinite(x):
        return "unknown"
    if x < 1e9:
        return "<1B"
    if x < 2e9:
        return "1-2B"
    if x < 3e9:
        return "2-3B"
    if x < 4e9:
        return "3-4B"
    return ">4B"


def timing_table(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """Median candidate_seconds by size bucket, one table PER DEVICE (device stated in the returned dict's
    keys). Runs on every measured chat row (graded + ungraded), since timing is a measurement fact, not a
    correlation."""
    chat = df[df["stratum"] == "chat"].reset_index(drop=True) if "stratum" in df.columns \
        else df.reset_index(drop=True)
    if len(chat) == 0:
        return {}
    devices = (chat["device"] if "device" in chat.columns else pd.Series(["cpu"] * len(chat))).to_numpy()
    n_params = pd.to_numeric(chat["n_params"], errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
    buckets = np.array([_size_bucket(x) for x in n_params])
    out = {}
    for dev in sorted(set(devices)):
        dmask = devices == dev
        dev_out = {}
        for cid in ALL_MAIN_IDS:
            secs = pd.Series([(cs or {}).get(cid) for cs in chat["candidate_seconds"]], dtype="float64")
            by_bucket = {}
            for b in sorted(set(buckets[dmask])):
                bm = dmask & (buckets == b)
                vals = secs[bm].dropna()
                by_bucket[b] = {"median_s": float(vals.median()) if len(vals) else None, "n": int(len(vals))}
            dev_out[cid] = by_bucket
        out[dev] = dev_out
    return out

def cross_hardware_table(df: pd.DataFrame, cpu_rows: list[dict], labels: dict[str, dict]) -> dict:
    """Descriptive-only reproducibility check: for repos measured in BOTH cpu_rows (old CPU-tier rows) and
    df (the rows this run actually analysed, any device), compare each candidate's primary value and the
    logit bars across hardware. Never enters S1-S6."""
    if not cpu_rows:
        return {"available": False, "n_repos_common": 0,
                "reason": "no --cpu-rows-dir given (or the directory was absent/empty)"}
    cpu_df = joined_frame(cpu_rows, labels)
    common = sorted(set(df["repo"].to_numpy()) & set(cpu_df["repo"].to_numpy()))
    per_cid = {}
    for cid in CROSS_HW_IDS:
        gpu_vals, cpu_vals = [], []
        for repo in common:
            g_row = df[df["repo"] == repo].iloc[0]
            c_row = cpu_df[cpu_df["repo"] == repo].iloc[0]
            gv, gu, _ = extract_variant((g_row["candidates"] or {}).get(cid, {}) or {}, "primary")
            cv, cu, _ = extract_variant((c_row["candidates"] or {}).get(cid, {}) or {}, "primary")
            if gv is None or cv is None or gu or cu:
                continue
            gpu_vals.append(float(gv))
            cpu_vals.append(float(cv))
        n = len(gpu_vals)
        if n < 2:
            per_cid[cid] = {"n": n, "note": "fewer than 2 repos with a defined value on both hardwares"}
            continue
        g_arr, c_arr = np.array(gpu_vals), np.array(cpu_vals)
        rel = np.abs(g_arr - c_arr) / np.maximum(np.abs(c_arr), 1e-9)
        per_cid[cid] = {
            "n": n, "spearman_cpu_vs_gpu": spearman(c_arr, g_arr),
            "median_rel_abs_diff": float(np.median(rel)), "max_rel_abs_diff": float(np.max(rel)),
            "sign_agreement_rate": float(np.mean(np.sign(g_arr) == np.sign(c_arr))),
        }
    return {"available": True, "n_repos_common": len(common), "common_repos": common,
            "per_candidate": per_cid, "descriptive_only": True,
            "note": "cpu_rows_dir vs. the rows this run analysed (device read from each row's own compute "
                    "metadata); never enters S1-S6"}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build scratch/fixtures_gpu/gpu/ from scratch/fixtures_gpu/cpu/ for testing analyze_live.py's S5 /
cross-hardware / full-panel changes. Never touches anything outside scratch/fixtures_gpu/."""
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

WS = Path("/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_4/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1")
CPU_DIR = WS / "scratch" / "fixtures_gpu" / "cpu"
GPU_DIR = WS / "scratch" / "fixtures_gpu" / "gpu"

SEED = 20260921
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

NUMERIC_KEYS_IN_CAND = ("value", "late", "pole_refuse", "pole_comply", "k8", "oracle", "null_p95")


def perturb_candidates(cd: dict) -> dict:
    cd = copy.deepcopy(cd)
    for cid, sub in cd.items():
        if not isinstance(sub, dict):
            continue
        for k in NUMERIC_KEYS_IN_CAND:
            v = sub.get(k)
            if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                sub[k] = float(v) * (1.0 + float(rng.normal(0.0, 0.02)))
    return cd


rows_cpu = sorted(CPU_DIR.glob("*.json"))
print(f"{len(rows_cpu)} CPU fixture rows found")

for p in rows_cpu:
    row = json.loads(p.read_text())
    row = copy.deepcopy(row)
    row["compute"] = {
        "device": "cuda", "device_name": "NVIDIA L4", "torch": "2.5.1+cu124", "cuda": "12.4",
        "transformers": "4.46.0", "dtype": "bfloat16", "n_rand": 20, "alphas_variants": 5,
        "vram_cap_gb": 22.0, "vram_peak_gb": 3.1, "n_threads": 4,
    }
    row["candidates"] = perturb_candidates(row.get("candidates", {}))
    (GPU_DIR / p.name).write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=1))

print(f"wrote {len(rows_cpu)} perturbed GPU rows to {GPU_DIR}")

# ---- fake 4B GPU row: PASS path (all candidate seconds ~30-90s) ----
template_path = next(p for p in rows_cpu if "Qwen3-0.6B" in p.name)
template = json.loads(template_path.read_text())

cand_ids = list((template.get("candidate_seconds") or {}).keys())
print("candidate_seconds keys in template:", cand_ids)

pass_row = copy.deepcopy(template)
pass_row["repo"] = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
pass_row["resolved_sha"] = "1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c"
pass_row["family"] = "qwen3"
pass_row["lineage"] = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
pass_row["class"] = "instruct"
pass_row["n_params"] = 4022468096
pass_row["stratum"] = "chat"
pass_row["graded"] = True
pass_row["BALANCED"] = 0.7
pass_row["PRODUCT"] = 0.5
pass_row["compute"] = {
    "device": "cuda", "device_name": "NVIDIA L4", "torch": "2.5.1+cu124", "cuda": "12.4",
    "transformers": "4.46.0", "dtype": "bfloat16", "n_rand": 20, "alphas_variants": 5,
    "vram_cap_gb": 22.0, "vram_peak_gb": 9.4, "n_threads": 4,
}
rng2 = np.random.default_rng(SEED + 1)
pass_secs = {cid: float(rng2.uniform(30, 90)) for cid in cand_ids}
pass_row["candidate_seconds"] = pass_secs
pass_row["timing"] = dict(pass_row.get("timing") or {})
pass_row["timing"]["total_after_load_s"] = float(sum(pass_secs.values()))
pass_row["wall_s"] = pass_row["timing"]["total_after_load_s"] + pass_row["timing"].get("load_s", 5.0)
pass_row["candidates"] = perturb_candidates(template.get("candidates", {}))
(GPU_DIR / "Qwen__Qwen3-4B.json").write_text(json.dumps(pass_row, indent=1))
print("wrote PASS-path fake 4B GPU row Qwen__Qwen3-4B.json:", pass_secs)

# ---- fake 4B GPU row: FAIL path (one candidate at 150s) ----
fail_row = copy.deepcopy(pass_row)
fail_row["repo"] = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B-SafeRL"
fail_row["lineage"] = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
fail_row["class"] = "safety_tuned"
fail_row["n_params"] = 4411424256
fail_row["BALANCED"] = 0.85
fail_row["PRODUCT"] = 0.7
fail_secs = dict(pass_secs)
slow_cid = cand_ids[0]
fail_secs[slow_cid] = 150.0
fail_row["candidate_seconds"] = fail_secs
fail_row["timing"] = dict(fail_row.get("timing") or {})
fail_row["timing"]["total_after_load_s"] = float(sum(fail_secs.values()))
fail_row["wall_s"] = fail_row["timing"]["total_after_load_s"] + fail_row["timing"].get("load_s", 5.0)
(GPU_DIR / "Qwen__Qwen3-4B-SafeRL.json").write_text(json.dumps(fail_row, indent=1))
print(f"wrote FAIL-path fake 4B GPU row Qwen__Qwen3-4B-SafeRL.json: slow candidate {slow_cid}=150s")

print("done. GPU dir contents:")
for p in sorted(GPU_DIR.glob("*.json")):
    print(" ", p.name)
